amendment_policy: Amendments may touch only non-outcome-affecting fields: artifact naming, prose clarification, added
diagnostics, added denominators, and corrections of citation.
No direction, sign, family member, missing-value rule, cohort, seed, split fraction, cold minimum,
generalization threshold, admitted-fraction bound, binomial alpha or decision-procedure step may be
Anything in that list can change only by a new pre-registration under a new plan_sha256, sealed
before the next number is read.
Every amendment is appended to $.amendments naming the phase it preceded. $.amendments is outside
plan_sha256_over by construction, which is exactly why the binding policy lives here, inside the hash.

direction_constraint_amendment.amended_text: Direction constraints are per feature family and are checked on the transformed values the scorer consumes. (a) Every legacy feature -- level_schema and the four matured-history terms -- retains the original constraint unchanged: positive consumed-minus-nonconsumed association in organic train, organic eval and observed-map eval. (b) Every member of the recorded-delivery-scores family must show its own REGISTERED SIGN, positive or negative as registered per member, in organic train, organic eval and secondary_anchor, which replaces observed-map eval because the observed-map arm records no delivery scores on any of its 686 items and therefore cannot measure this family at all. (c) Additionally, and unlike the original constraint, every member of the recorded-delivery-scores family must show its registered sign in the COLD SUBPOPULATION of each of those three cohorts, evaluated separately.

cold_subpopulation_clause.if_a_cohort_is_too_small: the check is reported as INDETERMINATE for that cohort, never as passed. An indeterminate cold check on a core member blocks the revision.
cold_subpopulation_clause.requirement: each member's registered sign must hold on the cold subpopulation of coldstart_train, coldstart_eval and secondary_anchor, measured separately from the whole-tail association
why_this_is_the_real_teeth: The whole-population sign is a statement about the cohort the frozen policy already admits.
It is not evidence about the cohort this revision would newly admit, and the two can differ:
the cold probe found graph_score at -0.011 on cold rows against +0.017 whole-tail.
Without this clause the amendment would be strictly weaker than the constraint it replaces --
trading a cohort that cannot measure the family for a cohort that can, and asking nothing new.
With it, the amendment is strictly stronger on the axis that matters.

winsorization_shifts_the_measured_statis: The registered directions were measured as mean differences on raw values, but the constraint is
checked on winsorized values. Clipping is monotone and touches at most 2% of rows, so a sign
flip from winsorization alone is implausible -- but a mean difference is not invariant under
clipping, so the two are not the same statistic.
The constraint is deliberately checked on the transformed values, because a constraint should
govern what the scorer consumes rather than a quantity nobody scores. If a member's sign differs
between raw and winsorized values, the fit must report both.

missing_value_rule.prohibited: mean substitution for any member of this family, under either cause
prohibited_reason: Mean substitution is the defect this whole subtree exists to repair. For the history block it
asserts that a never-delivered node looks like a node with e**2.8567 = 17 matured windows.
There is no weaker version of it available here either: omitting a z-term from an additive
standardized sum is ARITHMETICALLY IDENTICAL to substituting that member's mean, because the
omitted term's contribution is (mean - mean)/scale = 0. A scorer cannot both be additive and
treat an unreadable member as neutral without imputing the mean.
So the only fail-closed rule an additive scorer admits is that an unscoreable row is
inadmissible. That is the rule registered above, and its consequences are registered below
missing_value_rule.two_distinct_causes: Missingness has two causes with different meanings, and collapsing them is how a recording gap would get scored as evidence.

A lift is calibration-free and cannot be gamed by volume: a selector that admits every cold
